doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 28 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 100) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 27, fan favor 34 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 100) ◈ the Witness — 9 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 97) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 50) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 8 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 52) ◈ the Relay —
